title: Initialize rust-ipfs client in transit main.rs
description: Wire the rust-ipfs 0.15.0 client into transit main.rs startup. Create an IpfsBlockStore backed by the real rust-ipfs node (not MemIpfsStore). The existing MemIpfsStore is used in tests only. Why: all downstream pipeline code calls ipfs_store.put_raw_block() and get_raw_block(); without the real client, no articles are stored or retrieved.
